reason: The JIT header names nested CCallHelpers types but only forward-declares the class. Include its definition explicitly for the JSCOnly LLIntOffsetsExtractor build. No executable logic changes.
setupJIT compares a CompilationResult enumerator, so the translation unit must include its definition rather than depending on a different file in a unified bundle. No executable logic changes.

The analyzed ModuleRequest loses the distinction between absent attributes and an empty with {} clause. Reject any present clause at the native module-analyzer boundary. This is an explicit QuickExcel syntax policy adjustment, not an import rewrite.

Respect the explicitly frozen ENABLE_API_TESTS=OFF build setting on Linux as on Windows. The upstream JSCOnly unconditional assignment otherwise overrides the cache flag and requires the excluded development test tree. No engine behavior changes.

The JSCOnly port on Darwin copies generated headers into JavaScriptCore.framework but leaves the interface include directories at the non-framework paths, so <JavaScriptCore/JSExportMacros.h> resolves to the system framework and compilation fails. Point the interface paths at the freshly generated bundle headers. No engine behavior changes.

JSCOnly intentionally does not define PLATFORM(COCOA). On Darwin it still compiles TimeZoneCocoa.cpp, whose observer duplicates the generic no-op listenForTimeZoneChangeNotifications() from TimeZone.cpp and breaks the link. JSCOnly workers are one-shot on macOS, so omitting the notification observer keeps the existing generic time-zone behavior. No executable logic changes.
